title: How is Chris Pratt connected to Joseph Stalin?
description:
Five real photos connect Chris Pratt to Joseph Stalin, through a governor and three presidents.

Chris Pratt → Arnold Schwarzenegger → Ronald Reagan → Richard Nixon → Harry S. Truman → Joseph Stalin

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
